No supplied output means public_valid_found=null; actual empty output means false
kappa=0 remains the independent primal nonzero-vector path; zero targets need an explicit separately timed policy

Record actual Slicer projection dimension, compiled backend limit 64, randomizations and kernel iteration limits
Include construction/reduction/database/targets/decode/reconstruct/public verify/IO/cleanup costs and every failed attempt
